42200.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: jeto jayanto padumo uppalo ca, padum'uttaro rakkhito pabbato ca, mānatthaddho sobhito vītarāgo, kaṇho ca buddho suvimuttacitto.

42201.commentary: (SNPa) yo attano dārehi asantuṭṭho hutvā vesiyāsu padussati

examples.text: sehi dārehi asantuṭṭho, vesiyāsu padussati, dussati paradāresu, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

42204.meaning1: being corrupt; being rotten; being spoiled
42204.commentary: (DNt) padussan'aṭṭhenā'ti adhammarāg'ādibhāvena, sammukhaparaṃmukhena, kiles'āsucipaggharaṇena ca pakārato dussan'aṭṭhena gaṇḍo.

examples.text: ejā'ti calan'aṭṭhena taṇhā vuccati. sā pīḷan'aṭṭhena rogo, anto padussan'aṭṭhena gaṇḍo, anuppaviṭṭh'aṭṭhena sallaṃ.

42205.meaning1: in the sense of being corrupt; in the sense of being septic
42205.commentary: (DNt) padussan'aṭṭhenā'ti adhammarāg'ādibhāvena, sammukhaparaṃmukhena, kiles'āsucipaggharaṇena ca pakārato dussan'aṭṭhena gaṇḍo.

examples.text: ejā'ti calan'aṭṭhena taṇhā vuccati. sā pīḷan'aṭṭhena rogo, anto padussan'aṭṭhena gaṇḍo, anuppaviṭṭh'aṭṭhena sallaṃ.

abhāv'aṭṭhena aniccato, ābādh'aṭṭhena rogato, anto padussan'aṭṭhena gaṇḍato, anupaviṭṭh'aṭṭhena sallato, sadukkh'aṭṭhena aghato, sampīḷan'aṭṭhena ābādhato, avidheyy'aṭṭhena parato, palujjan'aṭṭhena palokato, nissatt'aṭṭhena suññato, avasavattan'aṭṭhena anattato.

42206.meaning2: did wrong, offended against, was corrupted

examples.text: ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya, na me so tena sāsanakaro.

42211.meaning2: having defiled, having polluted, having spoiled, having corrupted

examples.text: te mayaṃ ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsimhā, te mayaṃ aññam'aññaṃ paduṭṭhacittā kilantakāyā kilantacittā.
gopālako sāyanhasamaye sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātetvā iti paṭisañcikkhati, ajja kho gāvo amukasmiñ'ca amukasmiñ'ca padese cariṃsu

yasmiṃ c'assā padese ṭhitāya evam'assa, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ agatapubbañ'c'eva disaṃ gaccheyyaṃ, akhāditapubbāni ca tiṇāni khādeyyaṃ, apītapubbāni ca pānīyāni piveyyan'ti tañ'ca padesaṃ na sotthinā paccāgaccheyya.

42214.commentary: (SNa) padesaṃ padesakārī'ti avasese tayo padesamagge karonto padesaṃ phalattayamattam'eva ārādheti.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, paripūraṃ paripūrakārī ārādheti padesaṃ padesakārī. avañjhānitv'ev'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sikkhāpadāni vadāmī'ti.
atha kho bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi, yena sv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, vihārena paṭham'ābhisambuddho viharāmi, tassa padesena vihāsiṃ.

42215.meaning1: who partly does; who does a portion of the work; who practices partially
42215.commentary: (SNa) padesaṃ padesakārī'ti avasese tayo padesamagge karonto padesaṃ phalattayamattam'eva ārādheti.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, paripūraṃ paripūrakārī ārādheti padesaṃ padesakārī. avañjhānitv'ev'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sikkhāpadāni vadāmī'ti.

chattiṃsakkhattuṃ kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sakko ahosiṃ devānam'indo, anekasatakkhattuṃ rājā ahosiṃ cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. ko pana vādo padesarajjassa!

42218.meaning1: king of the land; regional ruler

examples.text: rājāno nāma pathabyārājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mah'āmattā, ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṃ karontā anusāsanti. ete rājāno nāma.

42220.meaning1: existing in the place; occurring in the area (of)

examples.text: ek'ūnatiṃso vayasā subhadda, yaṃ pabbajiṃ kiṃkusal'ānuesī, vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni, yato ahaṃ pabbajito subhadda, ñāyassa dhammassa padesavattī, ito bahiddhā samaṇo'pi n'atthi.

42221.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of padesa
42221.meaning1: in part; partially; to a degree
42221.commentary: (SNa) padesaṃ padesakārī'ti avasese tayo padesamagge karonto padesaṃ phalattayamattam'eva ārādheti.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, paripūraṃ paripūrakārī ārādheti padesaṃ padesakārī. avañjhānitv'ev'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sikkhāpadāni vadāmī'ti.

42223.commentary: (ANa) vikārappattiyā padussati, paraṃ vā padūseti vināsetī'ti padoso. ubhayam'p'etaṃ kodhass'eva adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati
cittaṃ hi'ssa, bhikkhave, paduṭṭhaṃ. cetopadosahetu pana, bhikkhave, evam'idh'ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjantī'ti.
disvāna rūpāni manoramāni, atho'pi disvāna amanoramāni, manorame rāgapathaṃ vinodaye, na c'āppiyaṃ me'ti manaṃ padosaye.
yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye, sataṃ sahassānaṃ nirabbudānaṃ, chattiṃsatī pañca ca abbudāni, yam'ariyagarahī nirayaṃ upeti, vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya pāpakan'ti.
santi, bhikkhave, manopadosikā nāma devā, te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyanti. te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsenti.
n'āphusantaṃ phusati ca, phusantañ'ca tato phuse, tasmā phusantaṃ phusati, appaduṭṭhapadosinan'ti.

42229.meaning2: in the evening, in the dark

42231.commentary: (NIDD2) na te mārassa paddhagū'ti na te mārassa paddhā paddhacarā paricārikā siyā, buddhassa te bhagavato paddhā paddhacarā paricārikā siyā'ti, na te mārassa paddhagū. (THa) rañño aṅgassa paddhagū'ti catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi parisāya rañjan'aṭṭhena rañño aṅgādhipatino bimbisārassa parivārabhūto gahapativiseso tassa raṭṭhe kuṭumbiko ahū'ti yojetabbaṃ.

examples.text: y'āhu raṭṭhe samukkaṭṭho, rañño aṅgassa paddhagū, sv'ājja dhammesu ukkaṭṭho, soṇo dukkhassa pāragū.
etadaññāya ye satā, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, na te māravas'ānugā, na te mārassa paddhagū'ti.
padmaṃ yathā kokanadaṃ sugandhaṃ, pāto siyā phullam'avītagandhaṃ, aṅgīrasaṃ passa virocamānaṃ, tapantam'ādiccam'iv'antalikkhe'ti.

ekaṃ carantaṃ munim'appamattaṃ, nindāpasaṃsāsu avedhamānaṃ, sīhaṃ'va saddesu asantasantaṃ, vātaṃ'va jālamhi asajjamānaṃ, padmaṃ'va toyena alippamānaṃ, netāram'aññesam'anaññaneyyaṃ, taṃ vā'pi dhīrā muni vedayanti.

42240.meaning1: could be defeated; could be destroyed (by)
42240.meaning2: liable to be violated, assaulted, or plundered
42240.commentary: (ANa) duppadhaṃsiyo'ti dummocāpayo, gahitaggahaṇaṃ vissajjāpetuṃ na sakkā'ti attho.

examples.text: durāsado duppasaho, gambhīro duppadhaṃsiyo, atho atthe anatthe ca, ubhayassa hoti kovido.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni app'itthikāni bahupurisāni tāni duppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi

42242.meaning2: having destroyed, having assaulted, having plundered, having offended

examples.text: karaṇīyam'etaṃ brāhmaṇena, padhānaṃ akilāsunā, kāmānaṃ vippahānena, na ten'āsīsate bhavan'ti.
dvinn'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ upaññāsiṃ, yā ca asantuṭṭhitā kusalesu dhammesu, yā ca appaṭivānitā padhānasmiṃ.
lokajeṭṭho'ti sakalasattalokassa jeṭṭho padhāno.

42249.meaning1: able to make an effort; capable of striving; fit for exertion

examples.text: addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca caṅkame ānisaṃsā'ti.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu app'ābādho hoti app'ātaṅko, samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato n'ātisītāya n'āccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo samayo padhānāya.

42251.meaning1: wanting to make an effort; wishing to strive; intent on exertion

examples.text: alaṃ vat'idaṃ kulaputtassa padhān'atthikassa padhānāyā'ti. so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, tatth'eva nisīdiṃ alam'idaṃ padhānāyā'ti.
disvāna me etadahosi, pāsādikaṃ vat'idaṃ ambavanaṃ manuññaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ. alaṃ vat'idaṃ kulaputtassa padhān'atthikassa padhānāya. sace maṃ bhagavā anujāneyya, āgaccheyyāhaṃ imaṃ ambavanaṃ padhānāyā'ti.

42253.meaning1: striving resolutely; making a determined effort
42253.commentary: (MNa) padhānapahit'attaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsū'ti padhān'atthāya pesit'attabhāvaṃ vasanaṭṭhāne pariveṇasammajjanena pattacīvaraṃ gahetvā anubandhanena mukh'odaka-dantakaṭṭha-dān'ādinā ca upaṭṭhahiṃsu.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi, bahukārā kho me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū, ye maṃ padhānapahit'attaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan'ti.

42254.meaning1: devotes oneself to striving; commits oneself to making an effort
42254.meaning2: devotes oneself to striving; commits oneself to making an effort
42254.commentary: (DNt) padhānam'anuyuñjā'ti vīriyam'anuyuñjāhi, arahattasamāpattiyā anuyogaṃ karohī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: katapuñño'si tvaṃ, ānanda, padhānam'anuyuñja, khippaṃ hohisi anāsavo'ti.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
ime vuccanti padhānasaṅkhārā'ti. iti ayañ'ca chando, ayañ'ca chandasamādhi, ime ca padhānasaṅkhārā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, chandasamādhippadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo.
pasayha māraṃ abhibhuyya antakaṃ, yo ca phusī jātikkhayaṃ padhānavā, so tādiso lokavidū sumedho, sabbesu dhammesu atam'mayo munī'ti.
virato idha sabbapāpakehi, nirayadukkhaṃ aticca vīriyavā so, so vīriyavā padhānavā, dhīro tādi pavuccate tathattā.

42263.meaning1: strayed from the task; abandoned effort; given up striving
42263.commentary: (VINa) padhānavibbhanto'ti padhānato vibbhanto bhaṭṭho parihīno. (MNa) padhānavibbhanto'ti padhānato vibbhanto bhaṭṭho parihīno.

examples.text: yato kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ, atha me te pañca bhikkhū nibbijja pakkamiṃsu, bāhulliko samaṇo gotamo, padhānavibbhanto, āvatto bāhullāyā'ti.
disvāna aññam'aññaṃ saṇṭhapesuṃ, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya. so n'eva abhivādetabbo, na paccuṭṭhātabbo, n'āssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.

42264.meaning1: difference in effort; distinction in exertion
42264.commentary: (MNa) padhānavemattatan'ti padhānanānattaṃ. aññādisam'eva hi puthujjanassa padhānaṃ, aññādisaṃ sotāpannassa, aññādisaṃ sakadāgāmino, aññādisaṃ anāgāmino, aññādisaṃ arahato, aññādisaṃ asītimahāsāvakānaṃ, aññādisaṃ dvinnaṃ aggasāvakānaṃ, aññādisaṃ paccekabuddhānaṃ, aññādisaṃ sabbaññubuddhānaṃ. puthujjanassa padhānaṃ sotāpannassa padhānaṃ na pāpuṇāti… paccekabuddhassa padhānaṃ sabbaññubuddhassa padhānaṃ na pāpuṇāti. imam'atthaṃ sandhāya padhānavemattataṃ vadāmī'ti āha. (SNPa) satt'āhaṃ vā padhānam'anuyuñjanti, aḍḍhamāsaṃ, māsaṃ, dvemāsaṃ, temāsaṃ, catumāsaṃ, pañcamāsaṃ, chamāsaṃ, ekavassaṃ dviticatupañcachavassāni vā. ayaṃ padhānavemattatā.

examples.text: te c'assu imehi pañcahi padhāniy'aṅgehi samannāgatā, ettha pana nesaṃ, bhante, siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇan'ti? ettha kho n'es'āhaṃ, mahārāja, padhānavemattataṃ vadāmi.

42265.meaning1: punished by exertion; tortured by striving

examples.text: āraddhaṃ kho pana me, aggivessana, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho ten'eva dukkhappadhānena padhān'ābhitunnassa sato.

42266.meaning1: produced by effort; brought into being by exertion; generated by energy

examples.text: evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yaṃ taṃ tejaṃ vīriyā nimmathitaṃ padhān'ābhinibbattaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttin'ti.

42268.commentary: (DNa) padhāniy'aṅgānī'ti padhānaṃ vuccati padahanaṃ, padhānam'assa atthī'ti padhāniyo, padhāniyassa bhikkhuno aṅgāni padhāniy'aṅgāni.

examples.text: kadā nu'haṃ sabbhi samāgamesu, diṭṭho bhave dhammagarūhi tādibhi, yāthāvadassīhi jit'indriyehi, padhāniyo taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

katame nava dhammā bhāvetabbā? nava pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgāni, sīlavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, cittavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, diṭṭhivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, kaṅkhāvitaraṇavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, magg'āmaggañāṇadassana, visuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paṭipadāñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, ñāṇadassanavisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, paññāvisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ, vimuttivisuddhi pārisuddhipadhāniy'aṅgaṃ.

42269.meaning1: factor related to striving; component of effort
42269.commentary: (MNa) padhāniy'aṅgānī'ti padhānaṃ vuccati padahanabhāvo, padhānam'assa atthī'ti padhāniyo. padhāniyassa bhikkhuno aṅgānī'ti padhāniy'aṅgāni.

examples.text: ekam'ekenā'pi, bhante, aṅgena samannāgato so puriso mama santike hatth'ārūḷhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyya, ko pana vādo pañcah'aṅgehī'ti! evam'eva kho, rājakumāra, pañc'imāni padhāniy'aṅgāni.

42270.meaningLit: discourse on factors related to striving

examples.text: yaṃ yaṃ disaṃ padhāvanti, taṃ taṃ dvāraṃ pidhīyati, abhinikkhamit'āsā te, sattā mokkhagavesino.
idaṃ sutvāna nigghosaṃ, bhūridattanivesane, ariṭṭho ca subhogo ca, padhāviṃsu anantarā.
disvā isiṃ paviṭṭhaṃ, ahināgo dummano padhūpāyi, sumanamanaso adhimano, manussanāgo'pi tattha padhūpāyi.
sabbo ādīpito loko, sabbo loko padhūpito, sabbo pajjalito loko, sabbo loko pakampito.

42281.meaning1: moreover; and so; but; or; however
42281.meaning2: and, yet, but, out the contrary, and now, more over

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo pāvāya kusināraṃ addhānamaggappaṭippanno hoti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi
samaṇā samaṇā'ti vo, bhikkhave, jano sañjānāti. tumhe ca pana, ke tumhe'ti puṭṭhā samānā, samaṇ'āmhā'ti paṭijānātha.

42282.commentary: (THIa) vividhaṃ panaccakā'ti yantasutt'ādīnaṃ añchanavissajjan'ādinā paṭṭhapitanaccakā, panaccantā viya diṭṭhā'ti yojanā.

examples.text: diṭṭhā hi mayā sucittitā, sombhā dārukapillakāni vā, tantīhi ca khīlakehi ca, vinibaddhā vividhaṃ panaccakā.
idaṃ niccaṃ, idaṃ dhuvaṃ, idaṃ sassataṃ, idaṃ kevalaṃ, idaṃ acavanadhammaṃ, idañ'hi na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, ito ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atthī'ti
te kho evaṃ jāneyyuṃ, santañ'ca pan'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti, asantaṃ vā aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇaṃ n'atth'aññaṃ uttari nissaraṇan'ti.

42285.meaning1: or anything else; or any other

examples.text: yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ… yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu
mūlabījaṃ nāma, haliddi, siṅgiveraṃ, vacā, vacattaṃ, ativisā, kaṭukarohiṇī, usīraṃ, bhaddamūttakaṃ, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi atthi mūle jāyanti, mūle sañjāyanti, etaṃ mūlabījaṃ nāma.
pure puratthā purimāsu jātisu, cirappanaṭṭhe sucirappavāsino, ñātī suhajje sakhino samānayi, samaṅgikatvā anumoditā ahu.

42288.meaning2: gone to ruin; perished; destroyed; annihilated

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena jambucorakā… labujacorakā… panasacorakā… tālapakkacorakā… ucchucorakā… timbar'ūsakacorakā timbar'ūsake uccinitvā bhaṇḍikaṃ ādāya agamaṃsu. sāmikā te corake anubandhiṃsu.
tena kho pana samayena jambucorakā… labujacorakā… panasacorakā… tālapakkacorakā… ucchucorakā… timbar'ūsakacorakā timbar'ūsake uccinitvā bhaṇḍikaṃ ādāya agamaṃsu. sāmikā te corake anubandhiṃsu.
tena kho pana samayena jambupālakā… labujapālakā… panasapālakā… tālapakkapālakā… ucchupālakā… timbar'ūsakapālakā bhikkhūnaṃ timbar'ūsakaṃ denti.
yāni kho pan'assa honti sāṭheyyāni kūṭeyyāni jimheyyāni vaṅkeyyāni, tāni yathābhūtaṃ āvikattā hoti satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu.
sace pan'assa pubbe vuttanayen'eva verimhi paṭighaṃ uppajjati, taṃ mettāya vuttanayen'eva vūpasametabbaṃ.

42294.meaning1: is lost; is destroyed; perishes; is ruined
42294.meaning2: is lost, disappears, goes to ruin

examples.text: te evam'āhaṃsu, manaṃ vata, bho, anassāma, manaṃ vata, bho, panassāma.
mā vo amataṃ panassa.

42295.meaning1: was lost; disappeared; went to ruin
42295.meaning2: was lost, disappeared, went to ruin

examples.text: panādo opamañño ca, devasūto ca mātali, cittaseno ca gandhabbo, naḷo rājā jan'esabho.
taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā'ti? aniccaṃ, bhante. yaṃ pan'āniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā'ti? dukkhaṃ, bhante.
yaṃ pan'āniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ, etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante

42298.commentary: (DNa) atthe panāyatī'ti atthe jānāti passati, nayati vā pavattetī'ti attho.

examples.text: tatra su'daṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro pitu-aṅke nisinno viceyya viceyya atthe panāyati ñāyena. viceyya viceyya kumāro atthe panāyati ñāyenā'ti kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa bhiyyosomattāya vipassī vipassī tv'eva samaññā udapādi.
taṃ kho pan'āyam'āyasmā dhammaṃ sutvā dvayena vūpakāsena sampādeti, kāyavūpakāsena ca cittavūpakāsena ca.
